name: What is the installation process for energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the installation process for energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our installation process begins with an initial consultation and measurement. Once windows are ordered and delivered, our certified installers carefully remove your old windows, preparing the opening by cleaning and inspecting the frame. New energy-efficient windows are then meticulously installed, leveled, and sealed to ensure maximum performance and airtightness. Finally, we finish the interior and exterior trim, clean up the work area, and conduct a final walk-through with you to ensure satisfaction and answer any questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, precise measurement, careful removal of old windows, expert installation, sealing, finishing, and a final walkthrough.
